name: Sridhatrikrishna Staff Attendance Yantra – Lite
author: sridhatrikrishna

sections.description:
Free supervised staff attendance and employee attendance tracking for a shared workplace computer. Use it as a staff time clock to record clock-in and clock-out, review working hours and shift timesheets, and export administrator CSV reports. Suitable for supervised hospital, clinic and company attendance. Test on a staging site, keep recoverable backups, and review the privacy and security documentation before production use.

  • Administrators create staff records without creating WordPress accounts.
  • The administrator chooses each staff code or generates an eight-character code in the browser.
  • Codes are case-insensitive, hashed for authentication and encrypted for deliberate administrator-only reveal.
  • Enable any number of staff members; shift history is retained when access is disabled.
  • Set your own hospital/company name under Sridhatrikrishna Attendance > Setup.
  • A logged-in administrator supervises the shared-computer attendance page while staff enter their codes.
  • Explicit Check in and Check out buttons, with server-generated success/error messages.
  • Server-generated UTC timestamps; display in the WordPress timezone with DD/MM/YYYY dates.
  • Duplicate check-ins and check-outs are rejected; multiple completed shifts per day and overnight shifts are supported.
  • Administrator-only date-range reports and CSV export.
  • No expiry, paid unlock, staff quota, telemetry, API key, external service, camera or location permission.
  • No theme dependency; a shortcode provides the staff interface.

This edition depends on administrator supervision and is not independent proof of physical presence. Anyone who knows another person’s code could act as that person if the supervisor permits it. It contains no face recognition, GPS, registered-device restrictions, payroll, breaks, midpoint attendance, automatic checkout, record correction or scheduled email.

Optional Pro edition

Staff Attendance Yantra Pro — details and purchase is a separate paid WordPress plugin for employers who need administrator-approved photo/video face enrollment, live face checks, attendance-event geofencing, registered-desktop controls and expanded attendance reports. An annual licence covers one WordPress website used by multiple staff devices and includes Pro updates during the paid term. Hosting is separate; purchase terms and the final price are shown on the company website.

Lite remains fully usable without a purchase, expiry, employee quota or paid unlock. Pro code is not included or hidden inside Lite. Clicking the purchase link opens the company website; Lite does not send attendance data to it.

Pro Plus is undergoing additional checks and is not available for purchase.

Distribution

The same Free release may be available from the official website and the WordPress Plugin Directory. The website copy must identify its version and checksum and remain synchronized with the directory stable release. WordPress.org remains the update source for the directory edition; this plugin does not fetch or install executable updates from the publisher’s website.

Privacy

Stored by this plugin: staff name and identifier, enabled status, creation time, keyed one-way staff-code hash, encrypted staff code, check-in UTC time and optional check-out UTC time. Administrators can deliberately reveal eligible encrypted codes, view reports and export CSV. Protect administrator accounts, WordPress salts and backups because they control access to those codes. No biometric, raw video, phone, GPS, device fingerprint or IP data is intentionally collected by this plugin, and no attendance data or telemetry is intentionally transmitted to the publisher. WordPress, the host and security software may independently create logs or backups. Deactivation and plugin-file deletion retain records. Site operators must define employee notices, lawful purpose, access controls, correction, retention, export and erasure procedures. No legal compliance guarantee is made.
sections.installation:
1. Create a separate test WordPress site. Back up production before any later installation.
  2. Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin > select this ZIP > Install > Activate.
  3. Settings > General > Timezone: choose Kolkata for Indian Standard Time, or your workplace timezone.
    Under Sridhatrikrishna Attendance > Setup, enter your own hospital/company name.
  4. Under Sridhatrikrishna Attendance > Staff, add each person and type a unique code or use Generate code. Administrators can reveal a masked code later if a staff member forgets it.
  5. Create a private page with a Shortcode block: [skh_attendance]. Do not cache this page in a host/CDN/page-cache plugin.
  6. Keep an administrator signed in and present at the shared computer. Try Check in and Check out with a test staff code, then review Sridhatrikrishna Attendance > Reports.

Activation creates only this plugin’s dedicated shifts and staff tables and schema option. It does not create WordPress users or public pages or add staff automatically. Deactivation and uninstall retain attendance data, organisation settings and staff records. WordPress roles and permissions are not modified. This release does not provide an automatic erasure workflow.
sections.faq:
Where can I buy Pro?

Visit the official Pro product page. Pro is purchased and downloaded from the company website, not the WordPress.org Plugin Directory. Purchasing Pro is optional and does not change Lite’s existing features.

Can staff use one shared computer?

Yes. A logged-in administrator must remain present while one staff member at a time enters a private code.

Does the plugin verify location, face or device?

No. It records supervised code submissions and is not independent proof of identity, location, physical presence or continuous work.

Can an administrator reveal a forgotten code?

Codes created or replaced in version 0.5.0 or later are encrypted for deliberate administrator-only reveal. Earlier codes remain usable but must be replaced once before they can be revealed.

Does deleting the plugin delete attendance records?

No. Deactivation and plugin-file deletion retain the dedicated database tables and settings. Site operators must apply their own approved retention and erasure procedure.

Does the plugin contact the publisher or collect telemetry?

No. This release does not intentionally transmit attendance data or telemetry to the publisher or an external service. WordPress, hosting and security software may create their own logs and backups.
sections.changelog:
0.5.7

  • Removed an unnecessary development file from the release package.

0.5.6

  • Matched the translation text domain to the assigned WordPress.org plugin slug.
  • Removed publisher URLs that could not be reliably validated during review.

0.5.5

  • Preserved one-time consumption of administrator-bound notice and code-reveal tokens.

0.5.4

  • Adopted the distinctive Sridhatrikrishna-prefixed display name and requested slug.
  • Confirmed administrator capability and nonce protection on every data-changing request.

0.5.3

  • Prepared the Lite edition for public distribution and removed outdated distribution wording from Setup.

0.5.2

  • Generalised Setup and installation instructions for distribution to other organisations.

0.5.1

  • Standardized the product display name as Sridhatrikrishna Staff Attendance Yantra – Lite.

0.5.0

  • Introduced the Staff Attendance Yantra product name.
  • Added per-staff administrator-only code reveal with authenticated encryption at rest.
  • Codes created before 0.5.0 remain usable but must be replaced once before they can be revealed.

0.4.0

  • Added information about separate paid editions and a link to the official SDKH editions page.

0.3.0

  • Replaced staff WordPress accounts with administrator-managed staff names and private codes.
  • Added in-browser secure code generation and administrator-only supervised kiosk access.

0.2.0

  • Removed the five-worker quota. Any number of WordPress users can be enabled for attendance.

0.1.0

  • Initial isolated Free developer preview.
